skill.name: ecommerce-product-comparison
skill.description: Compare two to five selected products using supplied information or SocialDataX queries for Douyin and Xiaohongshu. Produce comparison tables with price conditions, sources, and missing information.
skill.summary: Compare selected products with consistent specifications, qualified prices, and traceable sources.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts match Markdown formatting, credential names, product identifiers, or readable Chinese text rather than dangerous behavior. One confirmed finding covers unpinned external package execution through npx, creating supply chain exposure during online queries. No evidence found of credential exfiltration, concealed payloads, or prompt injection attempts in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Online query examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y without pinning or reviewing the downloaded package.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and lock dependencies. Obtain user authorization before installation, and isolate execution with only the required service credential.

content.value_statement: Product comparisons become unreliable when specifications, package sizes, and price conditions differ. This skill organizes selected products into sourced comparison tables and identifies missing evidence.
actual_capabilities: Compare two to five user-selected products using supplied information or supported online product queries.
Retrieve Douyin product details by product ID or URL and Xiaohongshu details by SKU ID or URL through SocialDataX.
Distinguish SKU variants, package quantities, coupon prices, promotional prices, and price ranges before comparison.
Calculate unit prices only when quantities and units are known.
Produce Markdown tables with specifications, visible selling points, price conditions, sources, observation times, and missing information.
Explain differences and suitable use cases without selecting a winner when evidence is insufficient.
limitations: Online product queries support only Douyin and Xiaohongshu; other platforms require user-supplied product information.
Online queries require Node.js/npm, a SocialDataX API key, and sufficient service balance.
The workflow does not establish verified sales, market share, growth rates, or review sentiment from unavailable data.
Profit calculations require user-provided costs and fees; incomplete specifications or price conditions can prevent meaningful rankings.

use_cases.title: Compare a Shopping Shortlist
use_cases.description: Compare selected products by package size, price conditions, and visible specifications before making a purchase decision.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Competitor Comparison
use_cases.description: Document differences among selected competing products while separating seller claims from independent evidence.

use_cases.title: Check Procurement Options
use_cases.description: Compare supplier-provided product sheets, normalize unit prices, and list missing information for follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Supplied Product Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these two products using only the information below: [product details]. Show specifications, prices, sources, and missing fields in a table.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Supported Product Links
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these Douyin or Xiaohongshu products: [two to five links or IDs]. Use authorized online queries and focus on [criteria]. Include sources and observation times.
prompt_templates.scenario: Online comparison with configured SocialDataX access

prompt_templates.title: Normalize Package Prices
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these product records: [records]. Separate SKU and promotion conditions. Calculate unit prices only where units and quantities are explicit. List unresolved comparability issues.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate analysis of differing package sizes

prompt_templates.title: Build an Evidence-Based Competitor Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare only these selected products: [two to five records]. Evaluate [criteria] for [audience]. Separate marketing claims from evidence. Include sources, price conditions, missing data, and verification priorities.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced competitor comparison with evidence boundaries

best_practices: Provide two to five selected products and specify the comparison criteria.
Confirm matching units, package quantities, SKU variants, and price conditions before interpreting differences.
For online queries, authorize a reviewed CLI version and keep API keys out of prompts, reports, and shared files.
anti_patterns: Treating coupon prices, price ranges, and different SKU sizes as directly comparable.
Inventing missing specifications, reviews, sales figures, or unsupported product rankings.
Requiring online queries or credentials when supplied product information is sufficient.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill targets Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Online retrieval also requires access to its documented CLI or corresponding MCP tools.

faq.question: Which platforms support online queries?
faq.answer: Online queries support Douyin and Xiaohongshu. For other platforms, provide product text or tables rather than unsupported links alone.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: Supplied product information requires no API key. Online SocialDataX queries require SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY, Node.js/npm, and sufficient service balance.

faq.question: How are different prices compared?
faq.answer: The skill separates SKU variants and promotional conditions. It calculates unit prices only when units and quantities are explicit.

faq.question: What happens when product information is missing?
faq.answer: Missing fields are marked as unavailable. The comparison lists verification needs and avoids unsupported rankings.

faq.question: Does the skill modify products or accounts?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only and excludes account changes. Online CLI examples still execute an external npm package, which requires review and authorization.
